prerequisite: Do not publish/dispatch until the exact corrected compiler gate and independent control source review succeed. This file grants no waiver.

primitives.head: b0089c26473c7dcef6970b3c90ee9785481ff9df
primitives.adaptation: Only hosted guards, bounded PID-filtered AT-SPI traversal, Openbox/AT-SPI bootstrap, lossless pixel conversion and owned-descendant cleanup are adapted. Capture is split from geometry, cleanup adds stamped identities. No held-pane fixture/helper/schema/pin/claims or HOME override transfers.

settings:
schema_version = 3
app_theme = "dark"
ui_scale = 1.5
terminal_font_size = 14.0
show_status_bar = false
check_for_updates = false
limits: Source-only temporary research control; never merge. No local Cargo, native app, helper, provider, fixture or workflow execution is authorized while preparing it.

Actual scripts/run-development --browserless builds matched CLI/HOST/UI separately with development features in one shared dev-runtime target, CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2, serial arms. It does not establish integrated-browser or whole-feature suite acceptance.

Inherited HOME and CODEX_HOME remain unchanged. Only private XDG/TMP app state, editor-stub PATH prefix and task-specific Cargo/Rustup cache variables are used. Inherited authority and scale variables are never stripped or fabricated.

Physical windows/captures must actually measure1280x800 and900x600, with identical supported ui_scale1.5 settings and Xvfb96DPI configuration. Current internal native scale factor is UNMEASURED; no derived current600x400 viewport is claimed. Initial winit scale guess is supporting startup evidence only.

Twelve same-path synthetic real Git projects are opened through matched --no-start CLI in reverse12→01 order because production ordering is newest-first. No remotes, provider or synthetic IPC fixture is used.

Baseline is a whole-feature comparison, not an isolated reproduction of the later wheel regression. A verified absent modal after baseline Return/Space or a readable, stable final-row-unreachable wheel observation remains explicitly negative, followed only by conserved source/fixtures/sessions and verified dismissal/typing/clear/anchor reset. Negative cases never satisfy the product oracle. All ambiguous OCR/native/source/fixture/cleanup outcomes stop affected coverage; no coordinates transfer from after.

Pure native pixel capture after wheel never resizes, moves, focuses or repairs pointer. Return/space/click use actual XTest input; only native X11 line-wheel buttons4/5 are covered, not pixel/touchpad/physical-keyboard/Wayland/touch/submenu/right-edge menu behavior.

Safe Remove confirmation is observed only and cancelled; no destructive confirmation is activated. Name/path must lie within the bounded native modal content region, with initially focused Cancel. Independent actual-image review must validate that bounded region.

Tooltip five-image states and every native UX claim require independent review. Missing tooltip accessibility labels do not establish absence. No source or machine result alone grants native UX acceptance.
No live commercial provider, concurrent-agent workload, performance/frame/GPU/resource improvement, FW16 compositor or full-PR merge acceptance is established. Remaining PR gates are not waived.

Actual logs, exits, source/executable/config/fixture hashes, PID-filtered accessibility, ordered input/keycode receipts, geometry, native WebPs and cleanup failures are retained. Missing captures are explicit; no placeholder or invented pass.

Owned process identities are captured before waits and revalidated before signals; normal UI close and matched guarded private daemon stop precede final owned cleanup. Cleanup failure refuses the next arm/build. Screenshots remain artifacts only, off product branches.

Both before and after menu rows are observed through their own actual native PNG/WebP and raw Tesseract TSV, version, confidence, bounds and independently bound menu receipts. No coordinates/data transfer across arms. Duplicate/unknown/partial/low-confidence labels or ambiguous dismissal fail affected evidence. After exact modal/name/path/initial Cancel gates remain unchanged.

Only a readable before menu with no Remove row after bounded real wheel may yield an explicit negative observation with no activation target; related activation/limit cases remain UNRUN. Missing editor/Before activation states are recorded. AFTER missing target/editor labels, unreachable rows, OCR ambiguity or any input/cancel/conservation/cleanup failure remains failure, never a scoped before negative.

Cancellation propagates globally and refuses later cases/arms. Every gesture releases tracked keys/buttons in finally; arm cleanup verifies releases before dismissal or any later arm. Release failure and cleanup uncertainty remain fatal.

Matched read-only channel list must stay empty and chat capacity used/resident/spawning must remain zero, alongside project order/membership, empty terminals, editor receipts and Git file/ref conservation. No unexpected New channel action is waived.

Menu::operate and Widget::a11y_nodes are separate. Source on both pins does not publish menu rows into the native accessibility tree; header accessibility is separate and retained. This control uses pixels for menu rows and does not establish native menu accessibility. Native modal/Cancel and header/focus checks still use their actual PID-filtered accessibility tree. Existing follow-up #1768 tracks native MenuSurface/ContextMenu accessibility publication; no duplicate issue is created by this control.

Both arms explicitly configure supported tiny-skia; inherited ICED_BACKEND is recorded before the identical child override. Accepted captures are visible-root client crops, never direct-drawable images; original black/blank diagnostics are retained and cannot qualify. Mapped occlusion, state drift or failed numeric nonblank gates stop affected evidence. This does not establish default GPU/rendering performance.

Only recognized stale accessibility objects permit up to3 complete read-only query attempts within a5s retry budget, including property enumeration. Input gestures remain exactly once; unrelated/exhausted errors and cancellation propagate without feature-negative classification.
product_successor_note: Public independently reviewed test-only E0282 correction of Vec<keyboard::Key> inference. Production/native behavior is unchanged; compiler gate still must succeed at this exact successor.

ocr.route: Both arms independently; each uses only its own actual unchanged native full-window captures, bound menu and literal source label list
ocr.literal_matching: Full exact source labels, including punctuation; no fuzzy guesses or punctuation aliases
ocr.unreachable_confirmation: At least3 identical readable end slices and native glyph hashes after bounded real wheel. Actual images require independent review; no activation target is invented.
ocr.cross_arm_policy: Captured PNG registration arm must equal ACTIVE. No coordinates, rows, OCR evidence or menu context transfers across arms.

backend.inherited_value: Retained in context and arm receipts; identical explicit child override only, HOME/CODEX/authority unchanged
source_route: vendor/libcosmic/Cargo.toml: iced tiny-skia feature enabled on both product pins
iced/tiny_skia/src/window/compositor.rs: exact tiny-skia accepted; wgpu rejects that name
backend.runtime_receipt: Matched live native UI /proc environment must contain ICED_BACKEND=tiny-skia; runner/UI logs retained. No original-default GPU/performance equivalence is claimed.

capture.accepted_route: Actual visible root pixels, unscaled crop at Xlib XTranslateCoordinates absolute client bounds; root and drawable diagnostics retained
capture.geometry: XGetWindowAttributes plus XTranslateCoordinates to root; SCREEN0, actual1280x800/900x600 client must fit wholly inside the identical1600x1000 root. xdotool parent-relative geometry is diagnostic only. Native bounds remain absolute; OCR bounds remain original crop-local data and are translated for input only using that same frame actual client origin. No offset guesses, crop padding or repair during capture.
capture.occlusion: XQueryTree bottom-to-top siblings above every ancestor to root, including frame and override-redirect siblings; any mapped InputOutput overlap or changing/ambiguous state refuses OCR/acceptance
retained: Original direct-drawable diagnostic PNG and actual command exit
Unscaled client PNG and lossless WebP
Root/client absolute geometry, stacking, pointer/focus before and after
Original image digests and numeric nonblank metrics
capture.scope: Nonblank thresholds are a refusal gate, not visual correctness proof. Actual unchanged images still need independent review; no capture repair or retry.

accessibility_retry.scope: Complete read-only query including traversal AND requested properties; never native input/gesture/reset
recognized_stale_errors: GLib.Error domain atspi_error code1 with exact Unknown object /org/a11y/atspi/accessible or cache path message family
accessibility_retry.failure: Exhausted, other errors, disappearance or cancellation propagate; never absent-modal/feature-negative success. Original attempts/errors retained.
